final_topology.title: Azure Hybrid Cloud Hub-Spoke
final_topology.description: Secure hybrid cloud architecture with Azure hub-spoke topology, including a private ARO cluster in the spoke and shared services in the hub, connected to on-premises via ExpressRoute.
final_topology.topology_summary: The hub contains shared services such as a firewall and a bastion host. The spoke network includes a private ARO cluster. The on-premises network has an OCP cluster and databases, connected to the hub via ExpressRoute. Public web traffic is protected by a WAF.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' node (n_new1) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z_new1), which is linked to the 'Identity Server' (n12) for management purposes, indicating the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, nl3) and management links (e.g., nl5, nl6, nl7) that document data flows between various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data and workloads, such as 'Hub VNet' (z1), 'Spoke VNet' (z2), 'On-Premises Data Center' (z3), 'Non-Production Zone' (z6), and 'External Testing Zone' (z7). These zones are connected via peering and management links, indicating segmentation.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' node (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to various other nodes and zones, indicating the presence and management of a firewall.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node (n13) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for DNS resolution, indicating the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' node (n12) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) and other nodes for management purposes, indicating the presence of MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' node (n14) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for DNS filtering, indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node (n15) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for URL filtering, indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a well-defined network architecture with distinct zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z6, z7) and connections (e.g., zl1, zl2, zl3, zl4, zl5) that address segmentation, least privilege, and availability.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' node (n_new2) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), which is connected to the 'Identity Server' (n12) for management purposes, indicating the use of version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' node (n12) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1), 'Bastion Host' (n2), and 'ExpressRoute Gateway' (n7) for AAA integration, indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'ExpressRoute Gateway' node (n7) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'OCP Cluster' (n4) in the 'On-Premises Data Center' (z3) and the 'Identity Server' (n12) for management purposes, indicating the use of a VPN and connection to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' node (n20) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), which is connected to the 'Identity Server' (n12) for admin access, indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative tasks.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node (n16) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for intrusion detection, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' node (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to various other nodes and zones, indicating the performance of traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NAC' node (n19) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for network access control, indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Flow Log Collector' node (n_new3) in the 'Azure PaaS Services' zone (z4), which is connected to the 'Azure Monitor workspace' (n11) for flow log collection, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIPS' node (n17) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for intrusion prevention, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1x Controller' node (n_new5) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1), 'Bastion Host' (n2), and 'Penetration Testing Host' (n21) for port-level access control, indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' node (n18) in the 'Hub VNet' zone (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for application layer filtering, indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for production (e.g., 'Hub VNet' z1, 'Spoke VNet' z2) and non-production (e.g., 'Non-Production Zone' z6) systems, indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' node (n21) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z7), which is connected to the 'Pen Test Scheduler' (n_new4) for scheduling and to the 'Non-Production Zone Representative Workload' (n_struct1) for testing, indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.evidence: {"zone_id": "z6", "name": "Non-Production Zone", "zone_type": "cloud_spoke"}
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z6 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.evidence: [{"zone_id": "z7", "name": "Security Management", "zone_type": "management"}]
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of a detailed and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including their network addresses, hardware addresses, machine names, asset owners, and departments.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit inventory records are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system or a label indicating the presence of an asset inventory.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices and links, but there is no explicit evidence of version-controlled IaC or the use of secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating the use of IaC and secure network protocols.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Monitor workspace' (n11) in the 'Azure PaaS Services' (z4) with a link (nl3) indicating metrics collection from the private ARO cluster, but there is no explicit evidence of collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of network traffic flow log collection.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n21) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z7) with a link (nl16) indicating penetration testing access to the firewall, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating the schedule and process for periodic external penetration tests.
